description: Antigravity: An upstream rate-limit reply (429 with Retry-After and a Google error body) reaches the Gemini client as a 429 with the upstream's error body. The request goes inside Cloud Code's envelope with the account's project, and the reply comes out of its response field.

error.message: Resource has been exhausted (e.g. check quota).

exceptions.reason: The new core passes the upstream's Retry-After on to a rate-limited client (RFC 9110 section 10.2.3); today's Gemini path sends none.

error.message: Resource has been exhausted (e.g. check quota).
